requirement.description: Async iteration issues in receive_messages method causing 'async for' errors with 'got coroutine'
requirement.contract: The receive_messages method should properly return an AsyncIterator that can be used with async for loops. The method must correctly yield parsed message data without returning coroutines or improperly handling async iteration.

requirement.description: Context manager cleanup issues causing 'close' not to be called on transport
requirement.contract: The __aexit__ method must properly call transport.disconnect() and ensure cleanup occurs even when exceptions occur. The transport should always be closed properly when exiting the async context manager.

requirement.description: Missing proper async iteration handling in _stream_to_stdin method
requirement.contract: The _stream_to_stdin method should properly handle AsyncIterable prompts and ensure that stdin is correctly managed during streaming operations. It should properly close stdin after streaming when appropriate.

requirement.description: Incorrect handling of the task group lifecycle in connect/disconnect methods
requirement.contract: The connect method should properly manage the task group lifecycle and ensure that the _stream_to_stdin task is started correctly. The disconnect method should properly cancel and clean up the task group.

requirement.description: Missing or incorrect handling of async iteration in process_query method
requirement.contract: The process_query method should properly yield messages from transport.receive_messages() and ensure that the async iteration is handled correctly for one-shot queries.
